libraries.name: typeof
libraries.doc: Global function: the type name of a value, with Roblox-style names: Vector3 for vectors and the type name of each datatype, enum and instance.

libraries.name: Enum
libraries.doc: The enum tables. Enum.<Type> is an Enum, Enum.<Type>.<Item> an EnumItem with Name, Value and EnumType. Every item is a single object per VM, so items compare with == and work as table keys. Enum.<Type>:GetEnumItems(), :FromName(name) and :FromValue(number) are supported; Enum:GetEnums() lists the types.

libraries.name: EnumItem
libraries.doc: An item of an Enum, such as Enum.Material.Plastic. Stored in attributes as its enum type and item name.
